figures.finding: Directors' guild DAC sets recommended minimums, a floor for negotiation: a feature (telefilm over 70 min) director gets 10% of the below-the-line budget, ARS 840,000 per day beyond the contract; a series pilot of 31 to 60 min ARS 28,560,000 in total, an episode of 21 to 60 min ARS 16,380,000; the national feature budget costs the director at ARS 173,313,425.

value.status: recommended minimums (piso de negociación), not a collective agreement

figures.applies: Argentina, directors of features and series for TV and platforms without state subsidy (DAC, March 2026); national-feature budget projection March 2026.

figures.finding: DAC's minimums guarantee a feature director 50 working days of preparation, 22 of shooting and 15 to 20 of post-production for the director's cut; a 31-to-60-minute pilot 21, 7 and 6; and set the director's cut time by length, from 5 working days (20 min or less) to 20 (91 min or more).
